name: About Arjun
description: I'm Arjun Behl, an Electrical and Computer Engineering master's student at the University of Waterloo. I build mobile applications and AI-powered tools, with interests in embedded systems and the hardware behind AI.
facts: My experience includes mobile development at BeSociable Medias, research on advanced chip packaging for AI accelerators, and teaching support for Waterloo's Compilers course.
I enjoy turning ideas into working projects and learning through building.

portfolio.meta: Software development, AI applications and embedded systems

name: Projects
description: Three hackathon and game-jam projects from autumn 2026, each built with a team.

sections.title: CrisisRoom
sections.award: 1st Place · MLH Best Use of Vultr
sections.meta: CommuniHacks 2026 · Capacity Canada · with Jeff David Tieng and Ricardo Gao
sections.text: Practise a crisis before it happens. A team-built crisis rehearsal application for nonprofit boards: participants take leadership roles, discuss an unfolding situation, vote on decisions, and review AI-assisted feedback. I contributed to AI-assisted decision feedback and voice integration.

sections.title: Rhythm
sections.text: Health routines, connected. A health companion bringing movement, meals and useful assistant context into one place, combining activity tracking with an experimental camera coach and AI-assisted features.

sections.title: Dune Rush
sections.meta: Devin Game Jam – Kick005 · Built with Ali
sections.text: One track. Five worlds. A browser-based riding game built with 3D Gaussian splats: switch between five environments while the ride, physics and lap timer continue. Runs in a desktop WebGL2 browser.

sections.title: Teaching Assistant
sections.meta: University of Waterloo · ECE 351: Compilers · September 2026 – Present
sections.text: Grade labs and exams using course rubrics and provide written feedback. Coordinate grading and support exam proctoring.

sections.title: Research Assistant
sections.text: Researched hybrid bonding and 2.5D/3D integration for HBM-based AI accelerators. Examined process flows, reliability and scaling limits in advanced chip packaging.

sections.title: Mobile Application Developer
sections.text: Developed mobile application features with React Native, Redux and Firebase Authentication. Worked with a Node.js and PostgreSQL backend and helped debug issues across the mobile app and backend.
